name: Kappil Coast
route_elevation: artistic .18 m base with a smooth 10 m flyover; NOT surveyed

world.fictional_geography_notice: OSM-derived Kappil road/coast with an artistic Kochi-inspired infrastructure remix. Metro, transit route, buildings, promenade and flyover are fictional, not a geographic/survey claim. Marine Drive itself is pedestrian-only; this race road runs alongside an inspired promenade, not on it.
